capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: the same 22-module 118 kWh pack as the Dream Edition, where Lucid confirmed 118 is both usable and total (InsideEVs); Sapphire sheet 118 kWh.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Lucid battery data (MY26+ packs) gives chemistry ID "Li MM(NRMC) - C.F", read as nickel-rich NMC (the page does not decode it).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: 2024 hardware assumed for 2026 (Lucid battery data lists a Sapphire 22M pack for MY26+). Lucid 2024 Sapphire sheet: 900V+.

preconditioning.notes: Lucid: manual Start Preconditioning plus Smart Preconditioning (automatic when routing to a fast charger). Current software state; the page is not year-specific.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 2024 hardware assumed for 2026 (Lucid battery data lists a Sapphire 22M pack for MY26+). Lucid 2024 Sapphire sheet: 118 kWh (22 module) (via search excerpt).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2024 hardware assumed for 2026 (Lucid battery data lists a Sapphire 22M pack for MY26+). Lucid 2024 Sapphire sheet: up to 300 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Lucid Canada charging page: AC charging maximum 19.2 kW; Wikipedia lists 19.2 kW (240 V, 80 A) for every trim.
